CLI structured-output envelope (#117 WS1). src/utils/output.ts holds module-global request-scoped state (json flag, command, result, warnings, error); CLI is single-threaded per process so module scope is safe. SINGLE EMIT POINT is withCliInstrumentation (utils/instrumentation.ts): in JSON mode it sinks handler stdout into the byte-counter (does NOT forward to real stdout) so stray console.log can't corrupt the envelope, then emits one envelope via the original stdout writer in its finally. Commands NOT wrapped (stats, audit, info, manifest, config meta) rely on the post-parseAsync finalize fallback in index.ts (emitEnvelope if isJsonMode && !alreadyEmitted) — that's why index.ts uses parseAsync not parse. Commands gate JSON output on isJsonMode() (global state set by the preAction hook from --json/RVR_OUTPUT), NOT on local options.json — the local flag only feeds the hook via optsWithGlobals(). printError(msg, code?)/printWarning/handleError are JSON-aware. Contract (pinned by docs/design-117-cli-agent-parity.md): reverie:"1" (string), error.code reuses MCP names with NO E_ prefix (PROJECT_UNRESOLVED/NOT_FOUND/REQUIRES_CONFIRMATION/COMMAND_FAILED/... in output.ts ERROR_CODES — renaming bumps ENVELOPE_VERSION), warnings as {code,message} objects, confirm preview in error.preview. D3: --json reads moved bare→result (documented break).

GOTCHA when adding/auditing a command for JSON mode — every command is one of two classes and BOTH have a silent failure mode (found in PR #118 review):
1. INSTRUMENTED (wrapped in withCliInstrumentation): stdout is sunk, so you MUST call setResult(...) or the envelope ships with no result and the command's output is silently DROPPED (this was the config get/set bug). console.log is swallowed — never the source of truth in JSON mode.
2. NOT INSTRUMENTED (relies on finalize fallback): stdout is NOT sunk, so any console.log/process.stdout.write BEFORE an isJsonMode() early-return POLLUTES stdout alongside the envelope (this was the config examples/llm-instructions/completions + audit --follow bug). Must branch `if (isJsonMode()){ setResult(...); return; }` before any human output, OR refuse (audit --follow refuses with INVALID_INPUT because an unbounded stream can't be one envelope).
Also: advertised error codes must be PRODUCED, not just listed — printError defaults to RUNTIME, so encryption/decrypt/missing-value sites must pass explicit codes (ENCRYPTED_NO_PASSWORD/DECRYPT_FAILED/INPUT_REQUIRED) or agents branching on them never match. The error-code list in CLI_LLM_INSTRUCTIONS (llm-instructions.ts) and AGENTS_MD_TEMPLATE (claude-md.ts) now interpolates ERROR_CODES from output.ts so prose can't drift from the frozen set. run --json must check proc.error from spawnSync (status AND signal null on spawn failure → would resolve to exitCode 0 / ok:true).
